descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Ultrawings is back — bigger and more beautiful than ever.

Return to the skies across 5 all-new aircraft and hundreds of missions, set in a gorgeous, hand-crafted island world.

MOTION CONTROLS

Our groundbreaking motion control system returns. Use your own two hands to work the throttle, flip switches, and fly — if you can grab it in the cockpit, you can use it. New haptics let you feel every switch and the rumble of the engine.

[media]

A LIVING WORLD

Watch the sun rise as you climb off the runway. Cruise past boats carving wakes across the bay and traffic winding along the coastal roads. Fly clear mornings, golden dusks, and moonlit nights, while our unique weather system rolls in everything from overcast to crackling lightning storms. No two flights feel the same.

[media]

TONS OF GAMEPLAY

You'll keep unlocking new ways to play across a 40–60 hour adventure. One minute you're dogfighting enemy bogies in a WWII-era warplane; the next you're popping balloons with a dart pistol from an ultralight.
[media]

FEATURES

* Pilot 5 unique aircraft, including a helicopter, with your virtual hands.
* Explore all-new, hand-crafted islands, each about 3x larger than those in the original Ultrawings.
* Soar over a living world full of boats and traffic.
* Experience a full day/night cycle and a unique, dynamic weather system.
* Feel the action with all-new haptics.
* Dogfight rival pilots in up to 8-player online multiplayer.

Welcome back to Ultrawings, Pilot.
